baseline.source: results/profile_bf16_before3.json (40 steps, bf16, bs24, single device, no co-running job)
baseline.note: the profile is sync-bounded at 16 segment boundaries per step, so it reads ~250 ms higher than the async training loop; both are reported

items.what: audit the CANN operator surface before optimising
items.conclusion: aten::stft is native (aclStft, 2 device kernels) and already used; aten::_fft_r2c is a DFT-matmul decomposition (6 kernels), _fft_c2r 12 kernels, istft unavailable, F.fold fails with 161002, as_strided faults the vector core

items.what: feed the loss the target waveform from the dataloader instead of recomputing istft(target spectrum) every step (PYMSS_TGT_WAV)
items.why_less_than_the_83_ms_segment: the dataset now ships 68 MB more per step, so ~9 ms moves from compute to H2D and the CPU collate pays the rest

remaining_bottleneck.single_main_cause: one 871 ms backward that contains the model backward (62 levels of band blocks) plus three MR-STFT adjoints (each an rfft, 6 device kernels) plus one iSTFT adjoint; CANN offers no Irfft/IStft/col2im to replace them, so it has to be attacked as elementwise-pass elimination, not as operator substitution
